name: design-dna
title_zh: 「感觉像那个网站」到手就变成一套能落地的设计语言
tagline_zh: 丢一个参考站、一张截图或一句「想要那种高级感」，它先拆出配色、字阶、间距、圆角、动效这套可执行规则。
tagline_en: Drop a reference URL, screenshot, or vague vibe; it extracts colors, type scale, spacing, radii and motion into.
desc_en: Translate a vague visual direction, reference website URL, named product, or optional screenshot into an original, executable design language and apply it to a new web interface. Use whenever the user says make it feel like, inspired by, reference this site, match this vibe, translate this aesthetic, or wants a web UI based on a visual reference without copying its brand identity.
why_zh: 先归纳出可复用的设计语言，再生成界面，所以换一个页面风格依然成立，而不是把参考站像素级复刻一遍。
why_en: It abstracts a reusable design language first, then builds the UI — so the style survives on other pages instead of being a.
limit_zh: 只产出设计语言与前端界面代码，不出 Figma 源文件、不做品牌 logo 与插画；参考站是纯图片或需登录时抓不到。
limit_en: Outputs design language + front-end UI code only: no Figma files, no logos or illustrations. Image-only or login-walled references need your own.
title_en: A vague "make it feel like that site" turned into a.
